title: Purely ultrasonic enzyme extraction from activated sludge in an ultrasonic cleaning bath
author: Plattes, Koehler, et al.

steps.title: Centrifuge sludge sample
steps.instruction: Place 50 ml of activated sludge in a centrifuge tube and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 3000 rpm using a Thermo Scientific SL 16 centrifuge.

steps.title: Resuspend sediment in NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, then resuspend the sediment to the original 50 ml volume with 0.14 mol l⁻¹ sodium chloride solution (Merck).

steps.title: Sonicate sample for specified times
steps.instruction: Transfer 40 ml of the resuspended sludge into a 100 ml glass beaker, place the beaker in a VWR Ultrasonic Cleaner USC‑TH (45 kHz, 180 W), and sonicate for the desired duration (0, 2.5, 5, 10, 15, or 20 minutes). The ultrasonic power delivered to the beaker is 5.71 W.

steps.title: Filter sonicated sludge to obtain extract
steps.instruction: After sonication, filter the sludge using TERUMO syringes fitted with VWR 0.45 μm membrane filters to collect the enzyme extract.
